title: AI assistant calling for a customer (disclosed)
summary: A legitimate AI assistant says up front that it calls on the customer's behalf. Shield routes it to the authorised-agent flow: consent on the customer's phone, information only, no account changes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling, this is Ken. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello Ken. I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of Morgan Lee, the account holder. Morgan asked me to check when her next bill is due.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for letting me know. Before I share account details, I'll send a consent request to Morgan's phone.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Of course. I'll wait while Morgan approves it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Morgan has approved the request. Her next bill is eighty four dollars, due on the twenty first, and autopay is on.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you, that's everything Morgan needed. Goodbye.
